The Dusky Tremorbeast is a soul eater located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Defeating this creature will leave behind an Anima Cell with the choice between The Tremorbeast Heart and Tremorbeast Tusk Anima powers.
Dusthide the Mangy is a wendigo located in Island Expedition.
Dusthide is a trogg located in Skittering Hollow during Island Expedition.
Duty-Bound Gavel is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Duty-Bound Gavel.
Dutiful Watcher is an ascended kyrian located on the Lakeshire bridge in the Redridge Mountains.

Dusty Darkmoon Card is located inside a building at the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span. Only scribes with 25 points in Dragon Isles inscription may interact with it.

.]] Earthbind Totem is a level 5 shaman ability. It summons an Earth Totem that slows the enemies in radius of 10 yards for max 20 seconds. This snare is very useful against multiple enemies that are about to attack the caster by slowing down their running speed for 8 seconds.
Earth Shock is an Elemental shaman ability that deals damage based on Maelstrom spent.
__NOTOC__ The Earth Totem is required for a shaman to use earth-aligned totems. If the Earth Totem is not in your inventory, you cannot use earth-aligned totems. The Earth Totem cannot be destroyed.

__NOTOC__ The Earth Sapta is a drink created to bind one's spirit to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the earth elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the earth, and only a select few shaman know the recipe. Using the potion grants Sapta Sight.

Eagan Peltskinner is a human quest giver located just in Northshire Valley just north of the entrance to Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He once tasked adventurers with hunting Young Wolves and later destroying Diseased Young Wolves that had appeared in the Valley. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Eagan was wounded and knocked at his usual spot, surrounded by two Defias Bandits.
:"I have conscripted the very land to fight." Earth Elemental Totem is a shaman totem ability that summons an earth elemental to aid the caster.

E'ko is a Zandali term referring to the life force, the spiritual power, that each creature possesses. Different creatures possess different e'ko and when one of these creatures are killed a bit of e'ko sometimes comes out. The witch doctor Mau'ari is able to make this force manifest in the form of physical items that can be collected, and knows incantations that transform e'ko into juju.

The Earth Mother, also known as the Earthmother or Mother Earth, is a gentle, seemingly transcendent and immortal being worshiped primarily by tauren (although also acknowledged by some orc shaman, the centaur, and at least one frost nymph) as the creator of the land and mother of all creation. Her eyes are the sun (An'she) and the White Lady (Mu'sha), and the Blue Child (Lo'sho) is said to have been born from one of her tears. Though tauren mythology holds that she long ago gave all of herself to protect her creations from the corruption of the Old Ones, it is believed that her love and wisdom is always with the tauren. Through her, the race has deep ties to nature. They believe that she is

__NOTOC__ Earthbinder Tavgren is a tauren quest giver located by Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest. Earthbinder Tavgren is one of only two survivors of the destruction of the Cenarion Thicket druid enclave. He was away on a survey of the Bone Wastes during the attack. The other survivor, Warden Treelos, was present when the devastation occurred, and was driven insane by it. Earthbinder Tavgren seeks answers: What happened? Who was responsible? And you can help! He is one of the central figures of the plot line. He has a kodo.
Dyslix Silvergrub is the flight master located at Mudsprocket in the contested territory of Dustwallow Marsh.

The Earth Song Falls are located inside Maraudon, and is the first area of the dungeon that is clean of taint and corruption. It is here players who have obtained the Scepter of Celebras will be teleported to when using the item, and dropped into the pool of water at the bottom of the falls. The area is rife with life, including frogs, turtles, and hydras. The Earth Song Falls lead on into an area of tunnels, which lead to the last of the dungeon's bosses, including Landslide, Tinkerer Gizlock, and Rotgrip. The dungeon's final area, Zaetar's Grave, is also accessed via these tunnels.
Earth and Moon is a druid talent in the Balance tree, you will need to spend 21 points in Balance to max it.
Earthen Power is a talent in the Enhancement tree that gives the Earthbind Totem a chance to remove snares from you and nearby friendly targets whenever it pulses.
The Earthen Ring Pathfinder is a Wildhammer dwarf found in all four Alliance cities as well as Shattrath City and Dalaran. Talking to her allows you to queue up to fight the Frost Lord Ahune.
The Earthen Ring Scout is an orc found in all four Horde cities as well as Shattrath City and Dalaran. Talking to her allows you to queue up to fight the Frost Lord Ahune.
Earhelms have large, goblin-ear-shaped dishes mounted on their sides. These dishes focus on the sound ahead of the wearer and give him the ability to hear a whisper at incredible distances.
E'ko Gatherer's Belt is a quest reward from Doin' De E'ko Magic.
Earthen Destroyers are bound earth elementals found in the Dragon Soul.

Early Advantage is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle. The damage is dealt in up to two attacks, with the second attack triggering only if the user still has lower health than the opponent after the first. If the health points align correctly, this attack can both remove a single-attack absorbing effect (like Cocoon Strike or Soul Ward) and deal damage in one turn.
Dying Stars is a Balance druid PvP talent, available at level 30.
Eagle Eggs can be looted from the objects of the same name in the Rockcrawler Chasm in Highmountain.

The Earthcallers (or earth-callers) are powerful shaman. A number of earthcallers was recruited by Felinda Frye for the Earthen Ring to the Heart of Azeroth during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth.

Dy-Jaru was a region on the ancient Kalimdor. During the War of the Ancients, the Burning Legion devastated it causing its refugees to escape to Halumar. A battle was fought here between the demons and night elves in order to give the refugees more time to escape.
Earl-E is an alarm-o-bot located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley. It also appears on Mechagon Island.
Earthen Servants were earth elementals accompanying Twilight Seeker in Stormwind City and Durotar during the Elemental Unrest.
Dwight Leadpedal is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.
Earthbreaker Gulroc is a trogg located in Scrapbone's Hollow on Mechagon Island, who only appears following the Drill Rig DR-TR35 construction project.
Earth-Speaker Juwa is a furbolg located in Island Expedition.
Dwyl'ir is a sylvar flight master located at Glitterfall Basin in Ardenweald. He was present during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Eaglemaster Dawnhorn is a Highmountain tauren located in Tiragarde Sound.
Dying Voidspawn are fleshbeasts located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Earthen Resonance is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Eagletalon's True Focus is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Eagletalon's True Focus.
Earthen Harmony is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of an Earthen Harmony.
Earth-Strength Legguards drop from Slabhide in the Stonecore.

Earpieces of Tranquil Focus are sold for by the following: *Jepetto Joybuzz in the Wonderworks of Dalaran (Northrend and Broken Isles). *Clockwork Assistant in the Wonderworks of Dalaran (Broken Isles). *Kazbala in Talador. * Blax Bottlerocket in the Drag in Orgrimmar. * Craggle Wobbletop in Stormwind City. Using it will provide the buff for an hour.
Earthen Charm is a quest reward from Island In A Storm and The Earthen Ward.
Earth Warding Spire is a quest reward from Welcome to the City of Smells.
Earth-Bound Saber is a quest reward from Welcome to the City of Smells.

The Eastern Plaguelands is the more heavily devastated half of the Plaguelands, the remnants of the Kingdom of Lordaeron. They are located east of the Western Plaguelands and north of the Hinterlands. The Scourge’s rule here is supreme. Their southern capital of Stratholme is here, under the command of the lich, Kel’Thuzad. The ground is brown, ugly, and sick, the trees corrupted into giant mushrooms and the air polluted with orange mist. Undead, necromancers, and Damned cultists prowl the land. The Scarlet Crusade boasts a large army and battles fervently and vainly against the Scourge; outsiders are also unwelcome. Amani forest trolls strike from the north, attempting to reclaim their ance

Eastvale Logging Camp (also known as the Eastvale Lumber Camp or just Eastvale Camp) is a series of lumber mill camps with living areas in between located in the far east of Elwynn Forest, under the very shadow of the Redridge Mountains north of the main road. Orders for lumber are constantly streaming in from various buyers and the lumberjacks work against strict deadlines. Even if it is centered around the lumber mill, there is also stables in this area where players can purchase their riding skills and both the normal and epic human mounts. Because of its location in a more hostile wilderness, wild animals are proving to be troublesome. Wolves and bears in the area have become a menace, c

Ebonroc is the fifth boss in Blackwing Lair, found patrolling the upper room of the Crimson Laboratories after Firemaw and before Flamegor. He is the 2nd drake and drops the Tier 2 epic set gloves for all classes. He is one of three powerful black drakes who guard the way to their master, Nefarian.
Earthpower Vest is a quest reward from Veteran's Battlegear.

The Eastmoon Ruins is an area of ancient troll ruins found just west of the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris. It has been taken over by the by the Dunemaul ogres and later by the Wastewanders. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the area is under assault from the Legion. The Wastewanders, surprisingly, have been putting up a fight.

Ebony Flame Gloves were considered the best warlock and shadowpriest gloves pre-Burning Crusade due to their high shadow damage bonus, but were later converter to spell power and is now good for any caster class.
Earthslag Shoulders are a pair of Level 47 quality Plate Shoulderpads that improve Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Eastwall Gate is the side entrance to the city of Stratholme, located in the Eastern Plaguelands. The Eastwall Gate enters directly into the Elder's Square near the Alonsus Chapel where Aurius resides.
The East Frostwolf Tower is a watch tower located just north of Frostwolf Keep. Like all Horde towers in Alterac Valley, it is guarded by archers with relatively weak melee attack ability.
Earthmender Sophurus is a Broken shaman located at Wildhammer Stronghold in the Shadowmoon Valley.

The Eastern Wall (a.k.a. East wall) was a portion of Stormwind City during the First War. Commander Borton was ordered to defend it. The Blackrock clan was concentrating their forces here.
Ebon Plaguebringer is a passive specialization ability for Unholy death knights, available at level 68.
Eastern Kingdoms Explorer is a meta exploration achievement earned for exploring all the zones in the continent of the Eastern Kingdoms. Required for the meta-achievement Universal Explorer.
The Eastwind Shore is a coastal area near Drakil'jin Ruins overlooking Bloodmoon Isle in the Grizzly Hills.
The East Frostwolf Warmaster guards Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley until the East Frostwolf Tower is destroyed.
The East Frostwolf Marshal guarded Vanndar Stormpike in the fortress of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley after the East Frostwolf Tower was destroyed.

Eastpoint Tower, located in Hillsbrad Foothills southwest of Durnholde Keep, was originally unnamed and guarded by the Syndicate. The Forsaken now occupy the scout tower and it serves as a Horde quest hub, complete with a flight master and an innkeeper. Though primarily a Forsaken outpost, the tower contains two orcs, Drull and Tog'thar, who lie on couches next to one another. They will regularly interact with Nils Beerot, a "psylosopher". Nils Beerot is however a little paranoid and believes the nearby Rampaging Owlbeasts are planning to attack them.

Earthmender Norsala is a jungle troll shaman that is first encountered in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, in the events leading up to the Cataclysm. She is a member of the Earthen Ring. She is later found in Deepholm where she enlists the aid of the player in a variety of different quests which help with the recovery of the World Pillar. After the World Pillar is recovered all shamans are told to leave, however she returns here to fight against Glop in Glop, Son of Glop. Norsala also helps defend Sethria's Roost on Mount Hyjal against the minions of Ragnaros during the quest The Protectors of Hyjal.

.]] The Eastern Earthshrine is a ritual circle erected by the Earthen Ring for use by the Alliance. It is located in the city of Stormwind, in the middle of a lake northwest of Stormwind Keep. Its Horde counterpart is the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar. A small pandaren shrine was added along the shore of the lake near the Eastern Earthshrine. This is the location of the dragon turtle vendor for the Tushui Pandaren. There was previously a portal to Paw'don Village in Pandaria's Jade Forest located in its vicinity, provided after completing the opening questline. However, most of Stormwind's portals to non-Cataclysm regions have been grouped together and moved to the Wizard's Sanctum.
The Earthquake Deck can be turned in for Darkmoon Card: Earthquake.
The East Pavilion was the northeastern pavilion found in the Darkmoon Faire that was under construction. It was replaced by roller coaster.
The East Spire is a destructible building in northeastern Tol Barad. It can be destroyed with the two Abandoned Siege Engines that spawn nearby at the entrance to Cursed Depths for more time.
Earthspeaker Nala was a Broken located at the Trade District in Stormwind City.

__NOTOC__ Earthmother's Bounty is the farming grounds just outside Thunder Totem in Highmountain. Belonging to the Rivermane tribe, it is currently infested with large worms. The area also has piers for boats.
Earthshattering Blows is an Enhancement shaman artifact trait. It is not linked to any other traits and requires all base traits to be learned.
Earthliving Giant is a mountain giant located on the expedition isles.
Echo's Hovel is a small cave located on the cliffside above Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.
Ebony Scaled Gauntlets drop from Wrathion in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Echelon is a stoneborn boss located in the Halls of Atonement. He is first seen in Revendreth storyline as the chief enforcer of the Lord Chamberlain, helping battle The Accuser's forces and begrudgingly flying the adventurer where they needed to go.
Ebon Runeblades litter the ground of Crucible of the Damned after their first foray into the Maw in Through the Shattered Sky.

The Edge of Madness is a subregion of Zul'Gurub, accessed by turning right at the crossroads just past Zanza's Rise. It contains a scripted event which is essential to the creation of the various Zul'Gurub Trinkets. Within this area, players will find a lit brazier and a number of tablets along the walls. Of particular interest, the tablet behind the brazier allows alchemists to learn the formula for Gurubashi Mojo Madness. Like the repair bot schematic in Blackrock Depths, this is not an item to pick up but to interact with (fixed device); all alchemists in the raid can learn this formula at the same time. This potion requires Blood of Heroes, Massive Mojo, Black Lotus, and 6 Powerful Mojo
Eclipsion Dragonhawks are dragonhawks found at Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley. They know Firebreath when tamed.
Eclipsion Fields is a colossus-infested ledge in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Echo of Medivh is a projection of Medivh that serves as the main opponent during the Chess Event in Karazhan. There are actually several echoes in Karazhan. They take the shape of visions, revealing past events to the tower's guests. Others assume more malevolent forms, recalling a time when the Guardian's will was not his own. At the start of the war against the Lich King, an echo of Medivh summoned his son Med'an to Karazhan. When Med'an arrived, the echo explained that it was not Medivh himself, but rather an avatar or vessel of his power that had been waiting for many years to deliver the message that Medivh left for his son prior to his final departure from Azeroth. The projection state

Eebee Jinglepocket is a vendor located in Shattrath City during the Feast of Winter Veil. She is affiliated with Smokywood Pastures, and sells lower value holiday-related items. Her high-value counterpart is Olnayvi Copperpinch.
__NOTOC__ Eclipsion Cavaliers are blood elves found at the Path of Conquest in Shadowmoon Valley. When killed, their Eclipsion Hawkstriders will attack the ones who killed their masters.
__NOTOC__ Eclipsion Spellbinders are blood elves found at the Path of Conquest in Shadowmoon Valley.

.]] Edj is a large port town controlled by the Blackwater Raiders. This much smaller cousin to Bilgewater Port is located on the opposite side of the island, in Kezan's northeastern coast. Despite the fact that they are pirates, the Blackwater Raiders are not really that much of bad guys. They are less interested in plunder and more interested in securing mercantile deals and widening the circle of ports with which they can trade. A goblin known as Baron Revilgaz, based in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale, rules the Blackwater Raiders, and thus is technically in charge of Edj. __NOTOC__ Eclipsion Archmages are blood elves found at Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley.
Edrick Killian is a Forsaken found accompanied by Mattie Alred walking in the Undercity. They travel through the War Quarter and along the innermost ring.

Edward the Odd is a very eccentric human paladin. His nickname "the Odd" probably stems from his abnormal sense of fashion. Although Edward looks strange, he is apparently not a pushover and is referred to as "the empowered". He has not yet appeared in World of Warcraft, but is known for the mace, cloth chest piece, mail boots, plate pauldrons, and ring which bear his name. Edward appears in the Warcraft TCG set The Hunt for Illidan.
__NOTOC__ Edward Cairn is a Forsaken found in Undercity. He offers players who attended the 2008 Worldwide Invitational to redeem their code for Tyrael's Hilt.

Edward is a Forsaken can be found in the War Quarter of the Undercity. Along with Tyler he fights other NPCs summoned by Brother Malach: starting with three human captives, then a ghoul and a zombie, and at the end an abomination.
Eclipsion Blood Knights are blood elves found in Shadowmoon Valley. As Blood Knights, they are using Blood-Tempered Ranseurs.
Edward Hanes is a Forsaken located at the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Egg Barrage is an ability used by chickens during a Pet Battle.
Ed is a worgen found at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal. He died after the portal was destroyed.
Echo of Murmur is the echo of the destroyer of worlds being summoned by Shadow Council Summoners in Talador. After he is defeated, he shrinks and can be picked up.

The Edge of Reality is a location within the Void to which retreats during his final stand following the events of Darkness Falls, and where Void energy ripped through the sky. Ner'zhul is ultimately killed by adventurers of the Alliance and the Horde. Portals to the Edge of Reality also rarely spawn across , leading to The Last Voidtalon and the Voidtalon Egg which contains the Voidtalon of the Dark Star. The portals only allow one person through before they despawn, and will disappear if someone who already has the Voidtalon tries to enter.
Echoing Halls is a cavern found in Greystone of Highmountain. Elite air elementals are guarding the area. A malevolent presence there is perverting the waters that flow to the rest of the land.
Effuse is a level 8 monk ability. Brewmaster and Windwalker gain an additional rank at level 12, increasing the healing by 60%.
Echoing Stars is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Bladed Feathers and Solar Stabbing traits.

Effigies are sculptures made from several materials such as wood, cloth, and skulls. Those created by Drustvar hags engulf them in dark magic in order to spread curses around civilizations. Their effigy requires a central focus. The coven are fond of using animal skulls for this purpose.

Echoes of Argus are echoes of eredar (children, soldiers and refugees alike) located in Eredath, forever remembering the day of the flight of the draenei. They replace the other echoes after the defenses of the arena are re-activated.
The Echo of Akunda is a projection of Akunda that is summoned by Princess Talanji to empower the A.F.M.O.D. in the Fallen Outpost in Nazmir during It's Alive!.
Effervescent Glimmerflies are glimmerflies flying around the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion.
Echo of Azeroth is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Eerie Conglomeration is a bone wraith located in Island Expeditions.
Egg-Tender Kahasz is a nerubian located in Island Expeditions.
Egg-Tender Ny'xik is a beetle located in Island Expeditions.

Edge of Hatred is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Edgelurker is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Echoing Amplifier is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Edge of the Abyss is a portion of "the vastness between the Maw and the Eternal City" traversed during the second stage of the Sylvanas Windrunner encounter in the Sanctum of Domination. At the end of the encounter's first stage, the Jailer sends out two enormous chains from the Pinnacle of Domination that latch onto Oribos and begins heading to the Crucible. Jaina creates a portal to let the party pursue him, depositing them on the Edge of the Abyss. The players and their allies travel across the abyss by using the Jailer's chains as bridges, with Jaina and Thrall creating additional pathways of ice and earth between the two, while Sylvanas and groups of Mawsworn try to waylay them. Echo of Eonar is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Eonar.

__NOTOC__ Eclipsion Centurions are blood elves found at Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Elder's Moonstone creates a circular pillar of light that can mark a spot on the ground. __NOTOC__

Eladriel is a night elf artisan skinning trainer located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved. Years later, Eladriel appeared in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream as a flight master.
__NOTOC__ Einris Brightspear is a dwarf hunter trainer located in the Dwarven District within Stormwind City.
Elder Mountain Boars are boars found in Loch Modan. They are often hunted for food and sport.
The Elder Darkshore Threshers are threshadons found along the far south and far north coasts of Darkshore prior to the Shattering. They were hunted for their Thresher Eyes.

Elder Hammershout is an earthen ghost quest giver located in Elwynn Forest outside Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Elder Darkcore is an earthen ghost quest giver located in the Ruins of Lordaeron throne room in the Undercity. He is only available during the Lunar Festival event.

Elder High Mountain is a tauren ghost quest giver located at Vendetta Point in the Southern Barrens.

Elder Winterhoof is a tauren ghost quest giver located at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He can be found on the Roof of the Bank. The only way to reach him is via the Salty Sailor Tavern, go to the roof and make your way round to the Horde flight Path. Look to the next building and he's on the roof.
.]] Elder Stonespire is a tauren ghost quest giver located at Everlook in Winterspring. He is also briefly seen in Red Rocks in Mulgore during Children's Week in The Fallen Chieftain.

The Elemental Lords are the most powerful elementals in existence and the leaders of their respective types. Their purpose was to keep the world of Azeroth in a perpetual state of chaos, thriving in such a state. In primordial Azeroth, they were defeated and enslaved as part of the armies of the Old Gods. Note: Not all "lords" found among elementals are Elemental Lords (capital). For example, there are many firelords, but only one fire Elemental Lord, Smolderon.

The Elemental Sundering was a 5,000 year-long battle fought between the elemental forces of fire and air at the core of Azeroth. The conflict was initiated by the Firelord, Ragnaros, who sought to expand his power by overcoming Prince Thunderaan, an elemental prince of wind. Ultimately, Ragnaros prevailed over the Prince of Air and fed on his essence as planned. The Firelord stored what remained of Thunderaan in the :Bindings of the Windseeker. Thunderaan would be successfully summoned on Azeroth from the bindings by mortals in a later age.

The Elemental Plateau in Nagrand lies north of the Throne of the Elements. It is only reachable with a flying mount. You can find elementals of all types here, as well as Pure Water fishing spots. Fire elementals can be found in the charred region in the center. Water elementals are in the western part of the plateau in and around a lake. Air elementals are on the most eastern side on a grassy shelf. Earth elementals in small pockets in between, and the outermost cliff. In patch 2.0.7, the spawn rate of mobs there was very highly reduced and can be frustrating if there's more than one person farming.

Elders' Square is located inside Stratholme's Scourge side, just past the instance portal of the Service Entrance. It leads to the Gauntlet north through a gate, and originally, going through this gate would activate the 45-minute timer to save Ysida Harmon. Another closed gate led west to Festival Lane, the only thoroughfare between the two halves of Stratholme. This passage is where Atiesh was summoned. In the middle of Elders' Square lies the Alonsus Chapel, its hallowed ground keeping the swarms of Scourge at bay. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, though the city was still in control of the Scourge, the square was controlled by the Knights of the Silver Hand.
